rule: Module-fixed save definitions only: SaveableTypeDefiner base and type/container ids, SyncData keys and save header keys. They are constants of the module, versioned here and never derived from a world, seed or campaign. Per-world generated object ids (mnbl_<8 hex>_..., CampaignIdentity) are StringIds inside a campaign's game data and never appear in this ledger. Entries are append-only: an id or key, once listed, keeps its meaning; a change of a saved shape gets a new id or key, a new entry and a migration (MMR-50). tests/Persistence/fixtures/save-type-ledger.v1.json is entry 1 frozen; SaveBindingTests checks the ledger still begins with it and its last entry matches the code.

entries.note: The module defines no saveable types: a world binding is header strings, and the only campaign data the module saves are two SyncData lists of installed types.
